from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Inches
import os

pptx_path = 'Work/Brownbag Sessions/Harness Engineering/Harness_Engineering_SDD_Workflow.pptx'
prs = Presentation\(pptx_path\)

# Check for embedded images in slides
for i, slide in enumerate\(prs.slides, 1\):
    for shape in slide.shapes:
        if shape.shape_type == 13:  # Picture
            print\(f'Slide {i}: image found - {shape.image.content_type}'\)
        if hasattr\(shape, 'image'\):
            try:
                img = shape.image
                print\(f'Slide {i}: embedded image \({img.content_type}, {len\(img.blob\)} bytes\)'\)
            except:
                pass
print\('Done scanning'\)
